```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (#PCDATA|child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- nested parameter entity comment -->">
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity Content">
  %pe;
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment exploring parser state -->
  <?root-pi attr="value"?>
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section containing entities like &ent; and tags <tag> < &
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; extended with &base;">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:ext="http://xml.org/ext">
  <!-- Comment spanning multiple lines
       testing comment handling and node allocation -->
  <?ext:pi test="true"?>
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with <brackets> and &s;
    ]]>
    &complex;
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block directly following entity reference
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (case*)>
  <!ELEMENT case (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "Beta &ent-a;">
  <!ENTITY ent-c "Gamma &ent-b;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?test-pi param="start"?>
]>
<testsuite xmlns="http://test.org/ns" xmlns:ns2="http://test.org/ns2" xmlns:ns3="http://test.org/ns3">
  <!-- Comment inside root element -->
  <ns2:case>
    <?ns2:instruction target="run"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA inside namespaced element with entity &ent-c;
    ]]>
  </ns2:case>
  <ns3:case>&ent-c;</ns3:case>
</testsuite>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local-ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Internal Entity Text'>">
  %local-ent;
  <?db-config cache="false"?>
]>
<database xmlns="urn:db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Database root comment -->
  <?xlink:actuate state="onLoad"?>
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      &internal; inside CDATA is literal text, but outside it resolves.
    ]]>
    &internal;
  </record>
  <!-- Trailing comment -->
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, content)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Second &e1;">
  <!ENTITY e3 "Third &e2;">
  <?doc-info author="fuzzer" version="1.0"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:m="http://doc.org/math" xmlns:x="http://doc.org/xhtml">
  <!-- Document level comment with <>&"' chars -->
  <header>
    <?m:math mode="inline"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Header CDATA block with entities &e3;
    ]]>
  </header>
  <content>
    &e3;
    <x:p>
      <![CDATA[Nested CDATA block inside namespaced element]]>
    </x:p>
  </content>
</document>
```
